about_the_game:
The glory days of arcades have returned! Add some gaming excitement to your modern RPG with the High Score Arcade tileset! With over 30 games and machines to choose from, your arcade will be anything but boring.


The Arcade Tileset Includes:

Ground tiles:

5 types of dark flooring – concrete, large tile, brick, diamond, wood and small square tile
Simple blue and pink floor with white edge
Checkerboard blue/pink pattern with edge
Tiny checkerboard pattern, one with gray/blue and the other gray/pink.
Glowing floor patterns in diamond and hexagon
Crystal pattern
Tables with and without matching glow edges
and more!


Wall tiles:

Walls and roofs to match floor tiles! (Plus autotile window designs!)


Also includes:

A wide variety of glowing arches and various details, both horizontal and vertical
Glowing accent pillars
“Arcade” signs
Windows in various styles
30+ games and arcade machines
Vending machines in matching colors
Utility tiles like exit signs, security cameras, etc
More not mentioned here!


Events and Animations:

Includes small and large animated doors in several styles.


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
